Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 38 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Meera - 10 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Isha - 11 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms
2. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The fishermen's village - Day

[Rohan stands in the village. Anita and Meera stand near him.]

Rohan: "What lovely weather!"

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Rohan (surprised): "Mom, listen!"

Scene 2: The bathroom - Day

[Rohan stands in the bathroom. Anita and Isha stand near him.]

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[Rohan brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Anita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan takes a quick bath.]

Rohan: "Isha, listen!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[Rohan bursts out laughing.]

Anita: "How beautiful!"

[Rohan starts crying.]

Anita: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan smiles at Mother.]

Anita: "That was fun!"

[Rohan stamps his foot in anger.]

Anita: "That's great!"

[Rohan gets frightened and steps back.]

Rohan: "I really enjoyed today."
